name: Euro-area economy
summary: Euro-area flash composite PMI held at 51.7 in November and Germany's ifo index rose to 90.6; growth stays positive
state: The flash euro-area composite PMI was unchanged at 51.7 in November, slightly below the 51.9 expected (Trading Economics, 23 Nov). Germany's ifo business climate index rose to 90.6 in November from 90.1, published on 24 Nov (ifo). With the PMI above 50 and no sign of contraction across the bloc as a whole, the signal stays Normal, though France's activity is weakening.
for_you: Businesses and workers in the euro area face steady but modest growth. Exporters to Europe see demand holding up, with France the weak spot.
rubric_hit: Normal: composite PMI 51.7 > 50 and growth positive

sources.title: Trading Economics — Eurozone Private Sector Growth Holds Steady in November
ifo Institute — ifo Business Climate Index for Germany

why: The euro area is the UK's largest trading partner; stagnation there hits UK exports and European markets.
drivers: Energy prices, German industry, ECB policy, fiscal rules, China demand.

rubric.alert: Technical recession, or PMI < 45, or bond-spread fragmentation forcing ECB action.
rubric.normal: Positive GDP growth and composite PMI > 50.
